story:
Eastern Residential Solutions is a full-service residential contractor specializing in roof repair and replacement, siding installation, and seamless gutters. Whether it is new construction or an existing home in need of improvement, we have the solution to your home's exterior needs. We work out of 1 Keystone Place in Jessup, Pennsylvania, and out of a second office in Baltimore, Maryland.

We are the residential division of Eastern Roofing Systems Inc., one of the largest and most respected commercial roofing companies on the east coast. That parentage is the reason a homeowner in Carbondale or Clarks Summit gets crews, warranties, and back-office discipline that were built for far larger buildings. It is also why we are still going to be here when a warranty question comes up years from now — the thing that matters most in this trade and gets promised most casually.

Every job starts with our one-of-a-kind in-home estimate. We inspect the property, then sit down with you and go through exactly what we found and what each option costs, with financing available for the times a roof fails at an inconvenient moment. On storm damage, we work directly with your insurance company, and because our fee does not change based on what the policy pays, our only interest in that conversation is making sure the real damage ends up on the paperwork.

From Jessup we serve Lackawanna, Luzerne, Wayne, Pike, Wyoming, Monroe and Susquehanna counties. From Baltimore we serve Baltimore City along with Allegany, Anne Arundel, Baltimore, Calvert, Caroline, Carroll, Cecil, Charles, Frederick, Dorchester, Harford, Garrett, Howard, Kent, Montgomery, Prince George's and Queen Anne's counties. We are licensed in both states — PA HIC# 017000 and MD HIC# 161389 — and we hold Owens Corning Preferred Contractor status, which is what lets us put the longest warranty available on your roof.
